name: 23024 · Bumpass, VA
findings: ZIP 23024 (Bumpass) has 26 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23024 (Bumpass) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 23024 (Bumpass) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.
